title: Replace a growing dispatch chain with an extensible registry
prompt: src/notifications.py dispatches on channel type through a long if/elif chain, and src/renderer.py repeats the same chain to pick a template. Every new channel means editing both. Refactor to a registry: a channel is registered once with its sender and its template, and both modules resolve through the registry. Expose register_channel(name, sender, template) and available_channels() from src/registry.py. Behaviour must not change for the existing channels, and it must become possible to add a new channel at runtime without editing either module.
acceptance_criteria: notifications.send and renderer.render both resolve through the registry.
Existing email, sms and push behaviour is byte-for-byte unchanged.
A channel registered at runtime is immediately usable by both send and render.
An unknown channel raises UnknownChannel from both entry points.
Neither module retains an if/elif chain over channel names.
